listing.name: Return to Castle Wolfenstein / NeoRTCW
listing.summary: Run the NeoRTCW source port with your own Return to Castle Wolfenstein data.

steps.title: Choose the upstream build
steps.instruction: On Linux x64, choose the AppImage, Flatpak bundle or tar.gz. The tar.gz clients require glibc 2.38 or later, SDL2, zlib, Opus, Opusfile and Vorbisfile. The two desktop tar.gz archives need executable permission on the client files after extraction.

steps.title: Supply the original game data
steps.instruction: For an owned Steam installation the upstream engine can search standard Steam paths. For a manual desktop archive setup, copy the original files into main beside the extracted clients. For the AppImage, you can set an accessible game data root with +set fs_basepath and put main under that root. Single-player needs pak0.pk3 and sp_pak1.pk3 through sp_pak3.pk3. Follow the upstream list for the multiplayer packs. Leave the original game installation intact.

steps.title: Choose the client and preserve your profile
steps.instruction: Run iowolfsp for the campaign or iowolfmp for multiplayer using the executable for your computer. The Linux AppImage and Flatpak launch single-player unless --mp is the first argument. The iowolfded executable is the dedicated server. Before replacing the engine, back up the active fs_homepath and retain any custom fs_basepath and fs_game settings.

warnings: The Apple Silicon archive requires macOS 15 or later and loads sdl2, opusfile, opus, libvorbis, libogg, jpeg-turbo, and freetype from /opt/homebrew. The publisher supplies no Intel Mac, Linux ARM64, or Android package in this release.
The Windows x64 clients need a compatible zlib1.dll, which is missing from the publisher's 1.0.0 ZIP.
